senses.gloss: m. (transpos. of δύσχιστος) hard to split, an inferior kind of parchment, opp. to קלף, a split parchment of superior quality.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 32b:1">Ib. 32ᵇ</cite> sq.; <cite ref="Shabbat 79b:6">Sabb. 79ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>דּוּכְסוּסְטִין</he>. Y. Sabb. VIII, 11ᵇ (not <he>טון …</he>).
